newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: CSG/WINTERTHUR WORLD'S 3RD LARGEST ASSET MANAGER.
newsitem.headline: CSG/WINTERTHUR WORLD'S 3RD LARGEST ASSET MANAGER.

text.p: A merger of the Credit Suisse Group (CSG) with Winterthur Group will create the world's third-largest asset manager for private and institutional investors.

Lukas Muehlemann, chief executive of CSG and designated chief executive of the new combined group, also told a news conference that with a stock market capitalisation of some $37 billion, the group would be one of the world's 10th largest financial services companies.
Documents from the news conference showed CSG/Winterthur with assets under management of $465 billion, the third largest after Fidelity Investments' $520 billion and AXA/UAP with $500 billion.
The documents showed HSBC as having the largest market capitalisation of financial services companies with $94 billion.
